contract.title: R03 corrected satellite-network validity review
contract.goal: Act as a satellite-network and routing experiment reviewer. Verify whether the 5 MHz versus 2 MHz pair can identify genuine directed-ISL pressure without confusing zero-rate, geometry, access, NO_ROUTE, data/control overflow, control-plane failure, denominator change or incomplete drain. Check that pressure requires episode-coincident utilization and queueing on one directed link, the 5 MHz control must be no-pressure, and the adaptive stop/next-step logic does not expand the matrix. Return PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES. Do not edit files. Never emit example or placeholder evidence: every evidence item must use the exact github://fuguther/leo-direct-sim/blob/770eabb94cc32fea2e14b0b452a148dc459534ef/<allowed-path>#Lx-Ly form; omit a finding if you cannot supply that form.
acceptance: Verify the exact commit and declared artifact set.
Verify both arms share all declared controlled conditions except ISL bandwidth.
Check pressure requires same-directed-link queueing overlapping the same sustained high-utilization episode.
Check physical-invalid and drain-invalid branches precede every pressure claim.
Check the 5 MHz control cannot already be pressured when claiming a 5-to-2 MHz bracket.
requiredEvidence: Line-grounded exact-commit evidence with no placeholders
At least one mechanism counterexample or covered regression
Explicit open_items and PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES
